content:
We have a Lean competition set up for ten parametrized open problems in combinatorics:
https://tenchallenges.github.io/ten-challenges/
The submission system was adapted from Lean-Eval (https://lean-lang.org/eval/). Many thanks to its developers.
I am looking forward to seeing progress in the leaderboard!!

For more info:
